params.diamondCut_: Contains the facet addresses and function selectors.
params.initCalldata: A function call, including function selector and arguments.                     _calldata is executed with delegatecall on initTarget.
params.initTarget: The address of the contract or facet to execute initCalldata.

returns._0: The ownership transfer buffer time in seconds.

params.newOwner: The address to which to initiate a ownership transfer.

acceptOwnershipTransfer().notice: Accepts a confirmed ownership transfer. Final step of ownership transfer.

cancelPendingOwnershipTransfer().notice: Cancels a pending ownership transfer before it is accepted by the new owner.

confirmOwnershipTransfer(address).notice: Confirms a pending ownership transfer after the buffer period has elapsed.

create3(bytes,bytes32).notice: Deploys a contract deterministically using CREATE3.

create3WithArgs(bytes,bytes,bytes32).notice: Variant that performs a callback after deployment so the new contract can self-initialize         using factory-provided context (used by some DFPkgs and aware contracts).

diamondCut((address,uint8,bytes4[])[],ad.notice: Add/replace/remove any number of functions and optionally execute a function with delegatecall.

diamondPackageFactory().notice: Returns the DiamondPackageCallBackFactory wired to this Create3Factory.

initiateOwnershipTransfer(address).notice: Initiates a ownership transfer by storing `newOwner` as the pending owner.

isOperator(address).notice: Returns whether `query` is authorized as a global operator (for all functions).

isOperatorFor(bytes4,address).notice: Returns whether `query` is authorized to call the specific function `func`.

setOperator(address,bool).notice: Sets (or revokes) global operator status for an address.

setOperatorFor(bytes4,address,bool).notice: Sets (or revokes) per-function operator status for an address on a specific selector.
